chunks: The pilgrim, when he stands at al-Mash'ar, comes out of his sins.

key_terms.بِٱلْمَشْعَرِ: at al-Mash'ar, the sacred site of Muzdalifah in the hajj rites
key_terms.وَقَفَ: stood or halted in the prescribed rite

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of standing at al-Mash'ar during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith states the great spiritual merit of the pilgrim’s standing at al-Mash'ar during hajj. It indicates that this rite is a means for the pilgrim’s sins to be removed and forgiven.
